about: Bodies circling a centre on their own rings, each going round in the time its period gives, so inner fast ones lap outer slow ones, names riding along: planets and moons, satellites, electrons in shells, anything that goes round something else.

bodies.about: what goes round, from the inside out, split by |

periods.about: how long each takes to go round, in the same unit, split by commas

speed.about: how fast the whole picture runs

when.about: moments each body starts; else when its name is said, or one after another
